# OMP Strata

> Profile, lifecycle tool and acceptance evidence for running the stock Oh My Pi (OMP) coding agent against
> a stock, local Strata inference server on one Windows 11 + RTX host. It forks neither project and adds no
> proxy: every download is pinned by URL, size and SHA-256; stock `setup.py` runs unmodified from verified
> local inputs; Strata binds to loopback behind an API key; stock OMP runs in an isolated profile with every
> model role on the local server and no cloud fallback. Python standard library only. Qualified and current (2026-10-28,
> under the owner's overnight fleet authorization, after the post-landing correction): stock Strata v0.2.3 (engine
> 0.1.48) + stock OMP 18.12.6 on the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 pair in `rtx3090-win-a` (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S at the trained 262,144-token context, stock
> layer split with stock roles `--gpu-roles 0=main,1=helper` putting the RTX 4090 as Main staged last, pipeline
> windows 2, no batch slots, display on the RTX 4090, with the engine's 8 GiB automatic conversation cache;
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-parking-strata0.2.3-omp18.12.6`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-parking-strata0.2.3-omp18.12.6/qualification.json)).
> Stock Strata v0.2.7 (engine 0.1.52) + stock OMP 18.13.2 remains current on an RTX PRO 6000 at the trained 262,144-token context with four batch slots, the engine's 8 GiB conversation parking and 32K chunks
> (`win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2/qualification.json)),
> and on an RTX 5090 at 131,072 tokens (`win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2/qualification.json)).
> Qualified opt-in (held on v0.2.3 + OMP 18.12.6, owner decision 2026-10-23): RTX 5090 Coder IQ1_M at 262,144 tokens
> (`win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.2.3-omp18.12.6`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.2.3-omp18.12.6/qualification.json)),
> with a 36 GiB available-RAM startup floor, 21 pass and 3 not applicable; the v0.2.7 262K draft stays blocked on host
> RAM headroom (35.7-36.2 GiB available with the resident Docker Desktop/WSL VM against the unchanged 36 GiB floor;
> G16 recorded 35.8 GiB). The 131K profile remains the RTX 5090's current/default; this is an explicit opt-in.
> Stock Strata v0.1.40.3 + stock OMP 18.8.4 stays qualified for single-card RTX 3090 hosts
> ([ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.1.40.3-omp18.8.4/qualification.json)).
> The PRO and RTX 5090 131K roll back to v0.2.3 (engine 0.1.48) + OMP 18.12.6; the pair and v0.2.3 262K opt-in roll back to v0.2.1 (engine 0.1.46) + OMP 18.10.1:
> [PRO, 262K (v0.2.3)](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.2.3-omp18.12.6/qualification.json),
> [RTX 5090, 131K (v0.2.3)](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.3-omp18.12.6/qualification.json),
> [RTX 5090, 262K opt-in rollback (v0.2.1)](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.2.1-omp18.10.1/qualification.json),
> [pair, 262K default-split rollback (v0.2.1)](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-parking-strata0.2.1-omp18.10.1/qualification.json).
> The pair's [v0.2.7 roles manifest](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-parking-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2/manifest.json)
> is now draft: G10 measured only 1.03 GiB Windows commit headroom versus 27.3 GiB on v0.2.3 at the same 135.7 GiB
> limit; a later bench sampled 0.632-1.331 GiB. Engine 0.1.52's PLE policy locks the 26.8 GiB table in RAM and leaves
> the automatic conversation cache off. An engine fix or a multi-GPU profile capability for direct PLE reads must
> be measured and requalified. All receipts and the ledger remain evidence. The campaign's qualified pair row is
> terminal and stays historical; the manifest and dated DECISION.md correction govern current selection.
> The unmeasured v0.2.7 default-split draft, the default and split-32 v0.2.3 pair drafts and the v0.1.44.1 pair release remain draft, not qualified.
> Each current local ledger has 21 pass and 3 not applicable. Real-host v0.2.7 receipts cite `9d3cf88` on the PRO main
> run, `2e50d9a` on the RTX 5090 131K main run with its G15 rerun at `9d3cf88`, and `15c7426` on the pair roles main run
> (operator receipts G01-G05 cite `9d3cf88`; G00 and G06 cite `fd645b6` and green [CI run 40663594440](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/actions/runs/40663594440) at `9d3cf88`; the
> held v0.2.3 262K opt-in cites `5726674` with its G19 rerun at `a915c69`). The RTX 5090 131K main-run G15 failure
> (thinking-loop stop on the first post-interruption recall and no nonce in its client-abort control) stays beside its
> passing G15 rerun. Engine 0.1.52's PLE residency policy locks the 26.8 GiB PLE table in RAM on the PRO (~33.1 s at
> start; 8,192 MiB automatic conversation cache still enabled; 53.7 GB G10 commit headroom) and on the held v0.2.7
> 128 GB-RAM pair (~31.4-37.5 s at start), where it
> leaves the automatic conversation cache off (`/metrics` `conversation_cache`: `enabled: false`, `budget_mib: 0`; live prefix reuse within a session
> still works while conversation parking across sessions is off despite the historical `parking` token in the profile
> ID; G19 follows `/metrics`). Scored (G24): PRO 15/18 (pilot 5/6; v0.2.3: 17/18), RTX 5090 131K 16/18 (pilot 5/6;
> v0.2.3: 17/18), RTX 5090 262K opt-in on v0.2.3 14/18 (pilot 6/6; v0.2.1: 15/18), current v0.2.3 pair roles 14/18
> (pilot 5/6; held v0.2.7 roles: 13/18, pilot 6/6). Per task on v0.2.7: tool-loop 0/3 on PRO and pair, and 1/3 on RTX 5090 131K; multifile-regression 1/3
> on pair; every other task 3/3. Protocol counters (including malformed arguments and calls without results) are 0
> across all three measured v0.2.7 server profiles; all task failures stay counted. Scored batch walls are 828 s on the PRO
> (v0.2.3: 578 s), 732 s on the RTX 5090 131K (847 s), 831 s on the v0.2.3 262K opt-in (v0.2.1: 778 s) and 1,183 s on
> the current v0.2.3 pair (held v0.2.7: 1,194 s); these are not isolated decode latency. v0.2.7 ships its engine (0.1.52) as a separately
> versioned CUDA 13 component tarball staged into `runtime\strata\engine\`, with
> `locks/strata-python-cp313-win_amd64-strata0.2.7.txt` (26 hash-locked wheels adding textual 8.2.8 and its reviewed
> transitive closure); OMP 18.13.2 selects the stock `replace` edit tool for Qwen3.8 served IDs (with no edit-mode override) and links
> continuation session copies, and G13 classifies v0.2.7's key-gated `/tool-media/` route.
> On `rtx3090-win-a`, engine 0.1.52's stage order was admitted at `15c7426` after the 2026-10-28 pair roles measurement:
> stock roles (`--gpu-roles 0=main,1=helper`, RTX 4090 as Main staged last; layers 0-23 / 24-47, auto K=24) read a
> 100K-token prompt in 29.8-30.4 s (prompt reading 3,362-3,452 tok/s; decode 137-174 tok/s) against 30.7-31.2 s for
> v0.2.3 roles (3,293-3,352 tok/s; decode 140-176 tok/s), while a throwaway comparison arm with `STRATA_PLE_AUTO_RAM=0` (profiles cannot set it) restored
> the 8,192 MiB conversation cache at 31.15 s TTFT for 100K tokens versus 30.40 s for stock residency. The v0.2.7
> roles draft is held on commit headroom; v0.2.3 roles is current again, with its v0.2.1 default-split rollback.
> The PRO and RTX 5090 v0.2.1, v0.1.44.1 (including 262K opt-in), v0.1.43.1 and v0.1.43
> profiles, the pair's v0.1.43.1 and v0.1.43 profiles, and each host's v0.1.42 + OMP 18.8.9
> profiles stay earlier qualified history. All earlier failed gates and passing reruns remain published.

> keeps the display on the RTX 4090; its

> requires moving the display back to the RTX 3090. Single-card RTX 3090 profiles are not rollbacks
> while both cards are installed: they name GPU 0, now the RTX 4090. Earlier qualified history: on the RTX PRO 6000, stock Strata v0.1.41 + stock OMP
> 18.8.6 with the same choices at 262,144 tokens, then at 131,072 tokens, then the same choices on v0.1.40.3 + OMP
> 18.8.4, then OMP 18.8.3, then v0.1.40.2 + 18.8.0 without them; on the RTX 5090, v0.1.41 + OMP 18.8.6, then
> v0.1.40.3 + OMP 18.8.4, then stock Strata v0.1.34 + stock OMP 18.4.10, which also stays qualified on the
> single-card RTX 3090 and RTX 4090. Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by the
> Oh My Pi maintainers, the Strata maintainer, Qwen or NVIDIA.

## Install

- From a checkout, with the current candidate profile: `validate` → `fetch` → `install` → `keygen` →
  `start` → `launch-omp` → `stop` (`py -3 scripts\omp_strata.py <command> --profile <profile> --root <root>`).
- One integration root per candidate; nothing is written to the user's normal OMP configuration or to
  `%APPDATA%\Strata`.

## Boundaries

- Supported: the qualified profiles under `profiles/` (Windows 11, a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090, RTX 3090
  or RTX 4090, or the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 layer-split pair; every other profile is a draft or a rollback installation),
  text only, single user, loopback only.
- Remote use: the Mac Studio's current qualified route, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2`, runs stock
  OMP 18.13.2 through an SSH local forward to `win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2`,
  the PRO's current v0.2.7 262K profile. Its independent G23 passed on 2026-10-28 at `15c7426`: missing key refused
  before launch, wrong key 401, health RTT 8.0-41.4 ms and stream TTFT 0.316 s; tunnel drop failed the turn in flight
  with the prior transcript preserved, and nonce recall passed after tunnel reopen (1.04 s), client restart (0.78 s)
  and verified server restart (1.60 s). Its qualified rollback, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-strata0.2.3-omp18.12.6`,
  reaches the PRO's v0.2.3 262K rollback. The 0.2.1, 0.1.44.1, 0.1.43.1, 0.1.43 and 0.1.42 262K routes and
  `client-rtxpro6000-strata0.1.41-omp18.8.6` 131K route stay earlier history.
- Not supported: images, remote clients other than those qualified current and rollback Mac-to-RTX PRO 6000 routes, other
  operating systems, durable engine state across restarts, multiple tenants. Comparisons with other runtimes are
  separate, comparison-only tools.
- Security: loopback only, API key required on every model, control and metrics route, key in a user-only
  file, ambient provider credentials scrubbed from OMP's environment, no telemetry. Not a sandbox, a
  multi-tenant service or an egress firewall.

- [README](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata#readme): status, what the tool does, layout, host-free checks
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): the tested install, start, use and stop commands

- [Security](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): what is and is not isolated, observed egress, known defects

- [Decision](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/DECISION.md): integration readiness, usefulness, further investment
- [Baseline](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/BASELINE.md): the frozen component tuple and why it was chosen
- [Upstream](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/UPSTREAM.md): findings reported to Strata and Oh My Pi
- [Release ledgers](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/tree/main/releases): manifest, gate ledger, receipts and scrubbed evidence per profile
